note: Model weights the sidecar needs at run time. They are not in the repo (BiRefNet is ~928 MiB) and neither rembg nor MediaPipe checks what it loads. Pinned by sha256 here on the same principle as footage-by-hash: Block 10's definition of done is a golden run green on two machines, and an unpinned model means machine #2 can produce different mattes or masks from identical input with nothing in the repo able to explain it. rembg fetches its own weights to ~/.rembg/ on first use; the MediaPipe segmenter has no fetch-on-use path, so tools/cv/setup.sh downloads it into tools/cv/models/, which is gitignored. Verify with tools/cv/verify-models.sh.
